from collections import deque

def shortest_to_zero(n, arr):
    stack = []
    queue = deque()
    
    # Collect indices of zeros
    for i in range(n):
        if arr[i] == 0:
            stack.append(i)
            queue.append(i)
    
    while queue:
        current = queue.popleft()
        left = current - 1
        right = current + 1
        
        if left >= 0 and arr[left] != 0:
            arr[left] = abs(left - current)
            queue.append(left)
        
        if right < n and arr[right] != 0:
            arr[right] = abs(right - current)
            queue.append(right)
    
    return arr
